landing.title: Coordinate a child's support together — privately
landing.text: Parents and assigned specialists share a schedule and a development diary. Access is enforced by the server; administrators never see diary text.
landing.exampleTitle: How one observation helps a team coordinate
landing.exampleIntro: This illustrates a workflow; it is not a story about a real child.
landing.exampleParentText: “After a noisy transition, joining in is harder. A warning beforehand helps.” The guardian chooses whether the assigned specialist can see the note.
landing.exampleSpecialistTitle: The specialist sees what is shared
landing.exampleSpecialistText: The assigned specialist can use the visible note when planning a session and add observations within their permissions.
landing.exampleControlText: The guardian can review the access log and manage the specialist assignment.
landing.f1d: Sessions with the assigned specialist in one place.
landing.f2d: Observations with visibility control and full edit history.
landing.f3d: Guardians see who accessed their child's records.
landing.workspaceTitle: A shared workspace with clear roles
landing.statsTitle: A child stays at the centre of the plan.
landing.statOneLabel: connected sides: guardian and assigned specialist
landing.parentText: Plan sessions, keep observations, and decide who can read each entry.
landing.specialistText: Keep assigned families in view and record observations with a clear history.
landing.adminText: Manage accounts and review system activity without reading diary content.
landing.whyText: A single, permission-aware workspace helps families and specialists coordinate without scattering sensitive notes across chats and paper.
landing.step1: A guardian creates a sample profile using fictional data only.
landing.step2: The guardian connects an approved specialist and plans sessions.
landing.step3: Each person records observations within their access; changes are audited.
landing.privacyText: The server checks role, family relationship, assignment, and diary visibility on every request. Administrators cannot read diary text.
landing.finalText: Create an account to get started with the SEN Support workspace.

about.question: What is the platform for?
about.answer: SEN Support helps parents and assigned specialists coordinate a child's support: maintain a profile, view schedules, and use the diary within their granted access.

roles.question: How do the roles differ?
roles.answer: A parent manages the child's profile and team access. A specialist sees only assigned children and the sections available to their role. An administrator manages users and audit records; the diary is not available to administrators.

registration.question: How do I register?
registration.answer: On the registration page, choose Parent or Specialist and complete the form. Administrator accounts cannot be created through public registration. A specialist account appears in the assignment list only after an administrator approves it.

approval.question: Why is a specialist missing from the list?
approval.answer: Only active specialist accounts approved by an administrator are available for assignment. Ask an administrator to check the account status and approval, and make sure you are signed in as a parent with access to this child.

password.question: How do I reset my password?
password.answer: On the sign-in page, choose Forgot password and submit a request. Reset requires an email link, but an email provider is not configured for the public version yet. If no email arrives, contact your administrator; never send your password in chat.

profile.question: How do I add a child profile?
profile.answer: Sign in as a parent and open the child profile creation flow from the overview. Enter only necessary information, and use synthetic data in the demo environment.

team.question: How do I assign a specialist?
team.answer: Open the child's profile, select the Team tab, choose an available specialist, and confirm. If the person is missing, ask an administrator to check their account and status.

schedule.question: Where can I see the schedule?
schedule.answer: Open the child's profile and select Schedule. It is available to the parent and specialists assigned to that child.

diary.question: Who can see the diary?
diary.answer: The diary is available to the parent and assigned specialist within their access to the child. Platform administrators cannot see it. Avoid recording information that is not needed for support.

privacy.question: How is data access protected?
privacy.answer: Access is scoped by role and assignment to a specific child. The team and access log help show who is authorized to work with the data. Never share your password or send personal data in this chat.

medical.question: Can I get medical advice here?
medical.answer: No. This guide only explains how to use the platform and cannot assess a child's condition. For medical or crisis support, contact a qualified professional or a local support service.
